name: soyuz the descent module under its main parachutes
note: Crew spacecraft render model (tools/make_crew_models.py), the descent module under its main parachutes. Soyuz MS in orbit: orbital module forward (docking), descent module, service module and its two wings. Body frame: +Z out of the docking port, origin at the port's contact point.

sources.subject: attitude
sources.value: the sim hands in a full attitude (approach, docked, entry); this law is only its fallback
diameters and lengths rounded from the references; shapes estimated from photographs
sources.source: Wikipedia 'Soyuz MS': service module 2.72 m wide, 2.58 m long; descent module 2.17 m; orbital module 2.25 m with the SSVP probe forward; arrays 10.6 m tip to tip; one main parachute (1000 m2)

sources.value: white: white paint (operator liveries in launch photographs); black: black paint / carbon composite (interstages, legs); grey: grey paint (Soyuz, Long March detail)
